title: test(components): the four page: containers render their properties.children through SchemaRenderer (objectui#10872, batch 7)
body:
Part of #10872
Clause-②: no

**objectui#10872 batch 7: a committed runtime pin for the premise batch 6 rested on, and a report-only reading of the producer pull for the flat-props / envelope-key batch.** The diff is one new test file and one changeset with an empty frontmatter. No renderer, schema or published file changes. This PR keeps objectui#10872 open: `record:line_items` and the flat-props / envelope-key batch itself are outside it.

## What this adds

- `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-container-bag-children-10872.test.tsx`, 12 tests. It uses the harness of `block-nested-aria-11083.test.tsx`: the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry, inside `I18nProvider` and `ActionProvider`. Each of `page:card`, `page:section`, `page:footer` and `page:sidebar` gets three rows:
  - two distinct `element:text` children in `properties.children`. Both render inside the container's own element (the `Card` root, `section`, `footer` or `aside`), in the order written, and nowhere outside it;
  - control: no children. The container's element renders with no child element and no text;
  - control: an empty `properties.children`. The same empty element.
- `.changeset/10872-container-children-runtime-pin.md`: an empty frontmatter, so nothing is released. `check-changeset-presence` counts any file under `packages/components/src` as published source, so it needs this declaration.

## Premise 3 holds on all four containers

All four render their bag children, in order, inside their own element. That means batch 6 left no defect here, and this batch has nothing to stop on. The mechanism is batch 6's reading: the renderers read `schema.children` (`page:card` reads `schema.body ?? schema.children`), and `SchemaRenderer`'s `properties` hoist copies the bag's keys onto the node they read.

## Ablation (one leg, committed state, restore proven)

I used objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode on `containers.tsx`. It replaced the anchor `const body = schema?.body ?? schema?.children;` (1 hit) with `const body = schema?.body; /* ABLATION-10872 */`, which makes `page:card` ignore its child list, and then ran the pin.
- Mutation landed: anchor 1 to 0, marker 0 to 1, blob `c07608e4cc2a` to `9329d02aae9b`.
- Predicted: only `page:card`'s bag row goes red. Observed: `Tests  1 failed | 11 passed (12)`, and the failed row is "page:card / renders both bag children, inside its own element, in the order written". Both `page:card` controls and all three other containers stayed green.
- Restore: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (c07608e4cc2a) and git diff HEAD is empty`. A separate read afterwards: marker 0, anchor 1, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes.
- The pin imports the renderers by relative `src` path, so there is no dist leg.

## The pull for the flat-props / envelope-key batch (report-only, no code)

Measured before anyone orders that batch, as release `5913855402` asks. The population is the 29 public-block arm types (the `PublicBlockComponentSchema` arms plus `object-metric` and `object-master-detail-form`). I read their declared keys at runtime from the arms' `shape`.
- FLAT is a node-level key the node's arm does not declare. The tolerant face passes it unjudged; the strict face and the spec's `PageComponentSchema` refuse it.
- ENV is one of the six envelope keys (`events`, `responsiveStyles`, `dataSource`, `aria`, `visibility`, `responsive`) at node level.
- The instrument is the committed `body-dialect-census.mjs` scanner (`scanNodes`, `keepFencedCodeOnly`, `bucketOf`) with a scratch driver that reports every key on a node rather than only `body` / `children`.
- objectui was read at `0c95d3d8d` (the tracked files). objectstack was read at `origin/main` `1741c5dcb` through `git archive`, with no fetch and no edit.

| repo | producer | key | nodes |
|:--|:--|:--|--:|
| objectui | taught `action:button` nodes: AGENTS.md, 4 guides, the app-shell README, 3 skills files, 2 pending changesets | FLAT `actionType` 15 · `target` 5 · `icon` 4 · `variant` 2 · `params`, `endpoint`, `method` 1 each | 15 |
| objectui | `record:activity` doc snippets (`plugin-detail.mdx`, the plugin-detail README) | FLAT `limit`, `showCompleted`, `items` | 2 |
| objectui | code that builds nodes at runtime: plugin-form `ObjectForm` / `ModalForm` / `DrawerForm`, plus the console dev page `DevMasterDetail` | FLAT `objectName`, `mode`, `fields`, `details`, `submitText` and more on `object-master-detail-form` | 4 |
| objectui | code that builds nodes at runtime: plugin-dashboard `DashboardRenderer` / `DashboardGridLayout` | FLAT `objectName`, `aggregate`, `filter` on `object-metric` | 2 |
| objectui | code that builds nodes at runtime: components `action-bar` | FLAT `actions`, `variant`, `size` on `action:menu` | 1 |
| objectui | any non-test producer | ENV, all six keys | 0 |
| objectstack | any non-test producer (showcase 62 nodes, app-crm 2, platform-objects 34, spec src 142, content/docs 10, skills 5) | FLAT | 0 |
| objectstack | examples/app-showcase: `command-center.page.ts` 5, `styling-gallery.page.ts` 10, `test/sdui-styling/pricing-showcase.ts` 2 | ENV `responsiveStyles` on `element:text`, `element:button`, `object-metric`, `page:card` | 17 |
| objectstack | skills/objectstack-ui `rules/pages.md` | ENV `responsiveStyles` | 2 |
| objectstack | spec conversions `registry.ts` (the retired `responsive` conversion's input and output) | ENV `responsive` 2 · `responsiveStyles` 2 | 3 |
| objectstack | `events`, `dataSource`, `aria`, `visibility` | ENV | 0 |
| objectstack | create-objectstack templates | nodes of the 29 types | 0 (the population is empty, so this zero is not a lit one) |

Lit controls: the detector fires on the test buckets (objectui 337 FLAT and 15 ENV; objectstack 8 FLAT, for example `notARealKey`, and 21 ENV). Of the nodes of the 29 types, 204 of 566 in objectui and 525 of 592 in objectstack carry `properties`. The 29 `sdui.manifest.json` registration descriptors are excluded because they are not nodes.

**Faces, probed on source (spec 17.5.0):**
- Node-level `responsiveStyles` on `element:text`, `object-metric` and `page:card`: the tolerant face accepts it without judging the value (`7` passes); the strict face refuses it (`unrecognized_keys`); the spec accepts it and refuses `7`.
- Flat `content`, flat `actionType` + `target`, and flat `objectName` + `aggregate`: the tolerant face accepts them; the strict face and the spec refuse them.

**The two tiers the release names:**
- **The `sdui-parser` html tier** emits every attribute flat and child elements as a node-level `children`, by construction: `parseJsx` builds each node as the attributes spread with `type` set to the tag. `validateTree` judges node-level keys against the manifest's registration `inputs`. I probed it with objectstack's `sdui.manifest.json`:
  - the html spelling of a `page:card` with a title and two children compiles with 0 diagnostics, and both objectui faces refuse it;
  - the bag spelling through a braced `properties` attribute draws `unknown-prop "properties"` on this tier, and both faces accept it.
  - So the two tiers are inverses. Neither repo has an html-tier app page that uses these tags. One teaching site writes one: objectstack's skill `pages.md` writes an `object-metric` tag with flat `objectName`, `aggregate` and `label`.
- **The VS Code validator** writes nothing: its completions cover only the bare `input`, `textarea`, `button`, `card` and `text`. Its JSON schema is `additionalProperties: true`, and its only per-key diagnostic is for the retired `body`. It accepts every flat key and every envelope key with no diagnostic.

**What this means for ordering the batch** (a reading, not a ruling):
- **Refusal half.** The only authored metadata that writes flat row keys is the taught `action:button` nodes, already routed to objectui#11183, and the two `record:activity` doc snippets. The other writers are in-code synthesizers that no zod face judges, and the html tier, which writes flat by construction.
- **Envelope half.** One key has a measured producer: `responsiveStyles`. objectstack's showcase writes it on 17 nodes of these types (34 on all types, `flex` included), and objectstack's skill teaches it. The spec declares it, and `SchemaRenderer` renders it (ADR-0065 scoped styling). objectui's strict face refuses it by name, and PR objectui#11069 (open) moves `objectui validate` onto that face. The other five keys have 0 non-test writers.

## Acceptance notes

- **Carrier: PR objectui#11069.** Once `objectui validate` judges through the strict face, it refuses node-level `responsiveStyles` on every arm, because `BaseSchema` does not declare it. That includes pages in objectstack's showcase that the spec accepts. Noted, not filed.
- **Carrier: objectui#11183, the same family as the taught `action:*` nodes.** The two `record:activity` doc snippets write flat `limit`, `showCompleted` and `items`, which the spec's strict page component refuses. Noted, not filed.
- The inverse html-tier reading above is already carried by this card's flat-props batch (release `5913855402`). This is its measurement, not a new finding.
- I did not change the `__tests__/README.md` index. It lists only a few historical suites, and the order says not to restructure that directory.
- Commits end with the model-free trailer pair that AGENTS.md prescribes, and this body ends with the session-URL footer from the role file, instead of the harness's own attribution lines.
